Question: 当厂商支付高于市场工资的效率工资时____。
Options:
A. 经济在充分就业的状态下运行
B. 存在对劳动力的过剩供给
C. 不存在非自愿性失业
D. 劳动力市场在效率工资水平下出清

Need select correct. Efficiency wage: firms pay above market-clearing wage to motivate workers. This creates labor surplus (excess supply) because at wage above market clearing, quantity of labor supplied exceeds quantity demanded. Unemployment non-voluntary? If wage is above clearing, workers willing to work at lower wage cannot find jobs -> nonvoluntary unemployment exists. So A false (not full employment), C false (there is nonvoluntary unemployment), D false (labor market does not clear at efficiency wage; wage above clearing). B true: excess supply of labor.
